security.bearer_auth: Use the developer API key created at /developers/api-keys.

tags.bible_verses: Search and filter Bible verses by book, chapter, verse, and text.
tags.feast_days: Find saints associated with feast-day calendar dates.
tags.patronages: Browse patronage categories and their associated saint counts.
tags.religious_orders: Browse religious orders and their associated saint counts.
tags.saints: Search saint records and retrieve full saint profiles.

operations.get_health: Returns service status and PostgreSQL connectivity.
operations.get_saint_by_slug: Returns a full saint record and related aliases, feast days, patronages, religious orders, and JSON-backed profile locations/titles when available.
operations.list_bible_verses: Lists Bible verses with optional filters for book, book code, chapter, verse number, and text search.
operations.list_feast_days: Returns saints associated with matching feast days.
operations.list_patronages: Lists patronages with associated saint counts.
operations.list_religious_orders: Lists religious orders with associated saint counts.
operations.list_saints: Search saints by name, alias, biography, patronage, or religious order. Uses safe parameterized PostgreSQL queries and avoids duplicate saints from joins.
